(1) the establishment of marine protected areas is a process of planned social change that requires the participation of the people whose livelihood depends on the area being protected; (2) the establishment of a marine protected area is a political process, in which the interests of various groups must be considered and balanced; and (3) the establishment of such areas requires an understanding of the culture of the people who live and work in the area.
